text: He loves righteousness and justice; The earth is full of the lovingkindness of the LORD.
Blessed [fortunate, prosperous, and favored by God] is the nation whose God is the LORD, The people whom He has chosen as His own inheritance.
A horse is a false hope for victory; Nor does it deliver anyone by its great strength.
Let Your [steadfast] lovingkindness, O LORD, be upon us, In proportion as we have hoped in You.
